data.body: **[P2] Avoid reacquiring the owner lock from a weakref callback.** `_claim_exporter_lanes` dereferences weakrefs while holding this non-reentrant lock. If a lane loses its final external reference concurrently, releasing the temporary reference inside the locked loop can invoke `release()` synchronously and deadlock while reacquiring the same lock. Store callback-free weakrefs and prune dead entries during each claim, or defer callback cleanup until after unlocking; add a concurrent collection regression test.
